definitions.explanation: A professional player of shogi or go who competes in title matches for a living.

examples.english: To become a professional shogi player.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{若|わか}くしてプロ{棋士|きし}になった。
examples.english: She became a professional player at a young age.

examples.japanese: {棋士|きし}は{長時間|ちょうじかん}の{対局|たいきょく}でも{深|ふか}い{集中力|しゅうちゅうりょく}を{保|たも}つ。
examples.english: A professional player sustains deep concentration even over long matches.

notes:
Refers to a professional of shogi or go; which one is meant is determined by context. Go professionals are also called {囲碁|いご}{棋士|きし}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- プロ{棋士|きし}: a professional shogi or go player
- {棋士|きし}の{対局|たいきょく}: a match between professional players

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {騎士|きし}: a knight — a homophone written with different kanji
- {名人|めいじん}: Meijin — a major shogi/go title, and by extension a grandmaster
